guitar.notes: Styx's two guitarists used standard 70s rock gear; no singularly iconic instrument widely documented, low confidence.

tone.target: warm clean-to-crunch arena rock with chorus sheen and delay
tone.profile: warm clean-to-crunch arena rock with chorus sheen and delay
tone.summary: A warm, spacious signal chain utilizing a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) for the core tone, enhanced by Chorus and Digital Delay to achieve the required 'arena sheen'.

rig.name: Styx - Come Sail Away - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the signal into the amp for better definition and punch.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used as a general tone enhancer, simulating a clean boost pedal effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide the light 'crunch' required for arena rock without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its classic, mid-focused breakup character, fitting the 70s/80s aesthetic.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean headroom and warm character of a Fender-style amplifier.
Provide a bright, articulate sound suitable for clean and slightly crunchy tones.
Slightly scoop the mids and enhance clarity in the high end.
Add the required 'chorus sheen' and width to the sound.
Create a spacious delay effect without sounding like a wash.
Add wide, natural ambience to complete the 'arena rock' sound.
